name: Bournemouth University

facts.text: Bournemouth University's main Talbot Campus is at Fern Barrow, Poole (BH12 5BB), in neighbouring Poole rather than Bournemouth itself.
facts.sourceTitle: Directions to our Talbot Campus | Bournemouth University (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: Talbot Campus is a compact campus housing most facilities, including the BU Business School, the Faculty of Media & Communication, the Faculty of Science & Technology, the Doctoral College and SportBU.
facts.sourceTitle: Talbot Campus | Bournemouth University (search snippet; fetch returned 403)

facts.text: Lansdowne Campus, just outside Bournemouth town centre and close to Bournemouth station, hosts most Faculty of Health & Social Sciences teaching and the Business School's postgraduate programmes, with the Bournemouth Gateway Building's healthcare simulation suites and the Weston Library.
facts.sourceTitle: Facilities and campuses | Bournemouth University (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: Travelling between Talbot Campus and Lansdowne Campus takes about 10-15 minutes by car or regular bus.
facts.sourceTitle: Facilities and campuses | Bournemouth University (search snippet; page not fetched)

facts.text: Bournemouth University uses CAS Shield for international offer holders; some may be asked to complete a pre-CAS recorded interview about their decision to study at BU, with instructions given on CAS Shield.
facts.sourceTitle: CAS Shield - a step-by-step guide for international offer holders | Bournemouth University (search snippet; fetch returned 403)
